purpose: Select one finite Campaign070 historical-only disclosure-process improvement mechanism after Campaign069, before reading any Campaign070 quarterly row, stock-day source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_inventory.numeric_order_rule: Use compact-cache v4's exact 98-factor order, append Campaign068/higher, then Campaign069/higher exactly once; retain Campaign063 as the explicit structurally nonnumeric challenge.

finite_candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures whether the issuer shortened the filing delay for the same fiscal quarter versus one year earlier. This is a disclosure-process transition, not announcement freshness, current delay level, four-quarter consistency, peer crowding, or a financial-value rank gap.
Current delay and freshness are already terminal definitions and are not reopened.
Campaign052 and Campaign062 already freeze those mechanisms; Campaign070 changes only the same-fiscal-quarter year-over-year delay transition.
Choosing among scales, bins, thresholds, signs, or nonlinear transforms would create an unregistered transform search. Only one same-day average-tie percentile rank is allowed.
Only the exact prior-year same fiscal quarter is economically comparable and frozen; no alternate lag or lookback is searched.
No financial value, minute field, board, year, size, threshold, filter, regime, fitted weight, interaction, or model is permitted.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_announcement_delay_improvement_yoy_rank_1y
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: An issuer that files the same fiscal quarter faster than one year earlier may have improved reporting processes or lower information friction that remains under-reflected over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.event_formula: For each unique instrument/report_date event on the Q-DEC quarter-end grid, set current_delay=(announcement_date-report_date).days and match the exact same instrument/report_date minus one calendar year. Set improvement_days=prior_delay-current_delay.
selected_candidate.stock_day_formula: Make the current event effective on the first accepted session strictly after its announcement_date; on each stock day select the latest effective finite improvement state and compute its average-tie cross-sectional percentile rank.
selected_candidate.prior_event_rule: Exact same instrument and exact report_date shifted back one calendar year; no nearest event, prior quarter, or bridge is allowed.
selected_candidate.delay_rule: Both current and prior announcement delays must be finite nonnegative integer calendar days, and the prior announcement must be strictly earlier than the current announcement.
selected_candidate.availability_rule: The improvement becomes usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after the current announcement_date.
selected_candidate.same_effective_date_rule: Sort instrument/effective_session/report_date/announcement_date and retain the latest report per instrument/effective session.
selected_candidate.state_rule: Forward-fill only already-effective finite improvement_days inside each instrument; never backfill or bridge an unmatched fiscal quarter.
selected_candidate.cross_section_rule: On each stock day compute pandas-compatible average-tie percentile rank over exactly the finite improvement states on that stock-day identity cross-section.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing without an exact prior-year same-quarter event, valid nonnegative integer delays, a strictly earlier prior announcement, a current strict-next-session effective date, or a finite cross-sectional rank. Never impute, clip, winsorize, substitute, or choose a favorable event.

decision.next_action: Complete the 101-definition mechanism-overlap audit and freeze the exact 100-comparator coverage-first protocol before reading any Campaign070 source or candidate value.
